patterns.note: Asymmetrical grid layout for content sections, pairing large images with text blocks of varying background colors and sizes.
Extremely oversized, wide, bold sans-serif typography for the brand name ('AZIONE') used as a dominant visual element in both the hero and the footer.
Strategic use of deep, rich background colors (dark green, dark blue, black) for content blocks to create distinct visual sections and contrast with white text.
A compact, sticky navigation bar appears from the top of the viewport with a subtle slide-down effect after the initial hero section scrolls completely out of view.
A horizontally scrolling client logo ticker is positioned immediately below the hero, showcasing partnerships before the main content.

technique_notes: Full-bleed hero section featuring a large, bold brand name overlaid on a video or image background, which scrolls up to reveal subsequent content.
Content sections are structured in an asymmetrical grid, combining large, high-quality images with text blocks that utilize distinct background colors for visual separation and emphasis.

A compact, sticky navigation bar is revealed with a slide-down or fade-in effect once the user scrolls past the initial hero section, providing persistent access to site navigation, likely using css-keyframes or anime-js for the transition.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, wide, bold sans-serif display headings (~8-10x body) paired with elegant, medium-sized serif body text and small, uppercase sans-serif labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners for most elements, with very subtle rounding on image cards.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a comfortable grid spacing for content blocks.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold and oversized typography, particularly the 'AZIONE' brand name, which acts as a powerful visual anchor in both the hero and footer. The asymmetrical content grid with rich imagery and distinct background colors also creates a dynamic and editorial feel.
